<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial intervention:</strong> Chief Justice of India Surya Kant stated that the judiciary has proactively addressed &quot;digital arrest&quot; scams rather than waiting for parliamentary intervention.</li>
  <li><strong>Election preparedness:</strong> The Election Commission of India concluded a national round table conference with state commissioners, while the NDA held high-level meetings ahead of election results.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQd1lhSkZhakVya3dsZDdZVHlHLVp1SmY5dDF6czRxc3ZwaGtGY3UyMU1MdE5Nb3RWQlNIcW1nYkRKZ0pmM3UtMVdnYldWSHpqVDJlamJoeFgwekRXNzNzYVB1VmZGbDlPdEFKZE5tOVBxWTRZanVnTy0ta1FPdmlkaGx4YXBIWC1Ddm9iYWM2MEtyMzFuRnc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory outlook:</strong> A Parliamentary Standing Committee has proposed a new strategic direction for the regulation of India’s Virtual Digital Asset (VDA) ecosystem.</li>
</ul>
